Name: Easier Cave Puzzle
Author: atravita
Description:
This mod makes that one cave puzzle easier.

By default, it simply requires the player interact with the statue again before the next round plays; this allows you to take a breather between rounds. But optionally, you can slow down the patterns (by increasing the [font=Courier New]SpeedModifier[/font]) or make the flashes last longer (by increasing [font=Courier New]FlashScale[/font]). You can also cap the maximum number of notes in eacn round with [font=Courier New]MaxNotes[/font].

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]SpeedModifer[/font]: A multiplier that controls the gap between notes in the puzzle. Set higher to increase the gap between notes. [b]This can be set locally[/b] (1 = same as vanilla.)
[*][font=Courier New]FlashScale[/font]: A multiplier that controls how long the flashes of light last. Set higher for them to last longer. [b]This can be set locally[/b] (1 = same as vanilla.)
[*][font=Courier New]MaxNotes[/font]: Caps the maximum number of notes per round. (Default to 7, same as vanilla). [b]Host must set this - it is ignored for farmhands[/b].
[*][font=Courier New]PauseBetweenRounds[/font]: If set true, the puzzle will pause between rounds - you must talk to the statue again to continue. [b]Host must set this - it is ignored for farmhands[/b]. (Much thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/114778613/]unlitday[/url] for writing the dialogue for me!)
[*][font=Courier New]AllowReAsks[/font]: Whether or not the statue will repeat the pattern if asked to.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Probably best if everyone installs this mod in multipalyer.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods.
[/list]
Technical note: this mod heavily relies on transpilers and may not be compatible with any other mod that edits the cave puzzle.
